title: Ahoy! A Pirate's Growth for Ye!
description: Little Meng of Liyue Harbor seems to be perturbed of late...

mainQuestExcel.title: Ahoy! A Pirate's Growth for Ye!
mainQuestExcel.description: Little Meng of Liyue Harbor seems to be perturbed of late...

dialogs.text: *sigh* Can I really do this?
What's wrong, Little Meng?
Oh, it's you, Traveler. How do you do?
You look kinda upset, Little Meng.
What's the matter? Did the other kids stop playing that, uh, pirate game with you?
Eh? No, no. Little Lulu and Little Fei have just gone home, that's all.
I... wanted to have a little walk by myself, so I haven't gone back yet.
Won't your parents be worried?
They should still be at work.
But let's not talk about that right now. Can I ask you a question?
And what might that question be?
So... I've heard lots of people tell stories about you.
You've been to so many places and you've seen so much, so perhaps you can give me an answer...
Ooh, you're getting all serious now. What's the question?
I'd like to ask...
How does someone "mature"?
Maturity takes time.
So you're saying that people will mature naturally as they grow older?
But wouldn't we mature too late, then?
Well, if you want to take a trip out of the city, we can accompany you!
That's... I wouldn't want to bother you. And I doubt that something special would fall into my lap just because I went outside the city...
Instead, I'd like you to help me with something else.
I've heard people say that if you have problems that you can't solve, you can write them down into a drifting bottle and let those troubles float down the river...
That way, they might actually be resolved.
But I've also heard that there are lots of monsters outside. I don't think it would be safe to go alone.
So, could you protect me while I do that?
Sure.
Thanks a lot! Don't worry, I've got savings. I can pay you!
Let's go, then. First, let's go down to the Bishui River.
I'm on the case.
You need to have some special experiences.
Special experiences, huh... But I've never left Liyue Harbor in my life.
I'm afraid I don't have time to play at the moment...
Hahaha, I only play that game with Little Lulu and Little Fei. Since they're not around, the game is off for sure.
Are we there yet? Hmm... We've got to pick a good spot to send our bottle off.
We should find an upstream position if we want it to go out further...
Are we there yet? Hmm... We've got to pick a good spot to send our bottle off.
We should find an upstream position if we want it to go out further...

flow.stepDescription: Look for a place to release the drifting bottle

dialogs.text: What the... To think that these things existed... That was scary!
Thank you so much! C'mon, let's continue.
...Wait. Where's my drifting bottle? I was just holding onto it, but now it's gone!
Did I drop it while we were fighting that... that Whopperflower?
Please, help me find it!

Please, help me find it!
Where's that bottle gone off to...
Where's that bottle gone off to...

flow.stepDescription: Bring the drifting bottle back to Little Meng

dialogs.text: Phew... I was up all night writing that message. If we'd lost the bottle, I'd have to write it all over again...
Wow, an all-nighter? You sure have a lot of worries, huh?
Well... not really? I just really want to know how I can become mature.
I've looked at lots of sources and read a ton of books, but the more I read, the less I understand...
Hehe, and that's why I wrote all the questions I don't understand into that message, in hopes that I'd get an answer.
C'mon! Let's send our bottle off!
Hey there, Traveler! Have you found the drifting bottle yet?

dialogs.text: This looks like a good spot. Let's put the bottle in the water here.
I hope I'll get my answers...
You will.
Thanks! Alright then, let's head back into the city.
Still, will Little Meng's questions really be resolved with a little bottle floating down the river?
Perhaps this is just his way of comforting himself.
Really? Paimon feels like there's a lot he's not telling us...
But come to think of it, this whole maturity thing is pretty tricky, huh?

dialogs.text: Thanks so much for today.
This is for you. Please take it.
Oh, right. Could you keep what happened today a secret from Little Lulu and Little Fei?
This is a personal issue of mine. I don't want to drag their spirits down.
Okay then, I'm going home now. See you!
